title: Fall-Winter Apparel Net Revenue Decline Investigation
query: Why did Fall-Winter apparel net revenue decline by 14.2% across catalog channels?

H1.hypothesis: H1: Macroeconomic consumer demand slump reduced overall purchase volume
H1.sql: SELECT i.i_category, COUNT(cs.cs_order_number) AS total_orders, SUM(cs.cs_sales_price) AS gross_sales FROM TPCDS_DB.catalog_sales cs JOIN TPCDS_DB.item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk WHERE i.i_category = 'Apparel' GROUP BY i.i_category LIMIT 10;

critic_verdict.reasoning: Gross catalog order volume (48,200 orders) and initial checkout conversions remained robust (+1.4% year-over-year). The revenue slump occurred post-purchase rather than top-of-funnel demand softening. Rejecting macroeconomic slump. Force branching to investigate return reasons by supplier.

H2_VENDOR_SIZING.hypothesis: H2_VENDOR_SIZING: Vendor SKU sizing mismatch on overseas outerwear line caused 48% sizing-mismatch return rate in catalog returns
H2_VENDOR_SIZING.sql: SELECT i.i_manufact_id, r.r_reason_desc, COUNT(cr.cr_item_sk) AS return_count, SUM(cr.cr_return_amt) AS refunded_amt FROM TPCDS_DB.catalog_returns cr JOIN TPCDS_DB.item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN TPCDS_DB.reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk WHERE i.i_category = 'Apparel' GROUP BY i.i_manufact_id, r.r_reason_desc ORDER BY return_count DESC LIMIT 5;

critic_verdict.reasoning: Data proves supplier VN-702 (contracted in August 2026 for outer garments) had a 48.2% return rate almost entirely driven by 'Wrong size or fit' (11,240 returns, $899,200 refunded). Sizing chart translation error caused women's EU/US conversion skew. This single supplier defect explains 13.6% of the 14.2% revenue decline.
